On May 19, 1954, at 3:00 p.m., a UFO was observed by several people in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil. The object was described as a bright, silver disk with a dark center. It moved erratically, changing direction rapidly and making no sound. The witnesses included a group of students from a local university who were watching the sky as part of a meteorology study. They reported that the UFO remained in the sky for approximately 15 minutes before disappearing suddenly.
